The structure of Cr16V2O32 (reduced formula Cr8VO16) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 50 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Cr in tetrahedral coordination by four O neighbors and in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors, while V is octahedrally coordinated by six O neighbors. Cr tetrahedra share corners with Cr octahedra and Cr octahedra with V octahedra, and Cr octahedra share corners and edges with each other. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 50 sites.
